tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gsang thig snying po skor gsum gyi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs snying po zhes bya ba/1$0000300 chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje sems// sprul sku khrag 'thung rigs lnga dga' rab rje// rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad pra bha hasti la// gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dngos grub stsol// dkyil 'khor khyab bdag rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// bai ro tsa na ye shes mtsho rgyal yum// gter chen bla ma pad+ma gar dbang rtsal// gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dngos grub stsol// rigs kun bdag po bcom ldan rdo rje sems// bde mchog grub gtso badz+ra he ru ka /bar chad bdud 'dul rdo rje phur pa'i lhar// gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dngos grub stsol// dngos grub kun stsol ma sring mkha' 'gro dang*// phrin las lhun grub dam can rgya mtsho'i sde// dam tshig rjes gcod gter srung tshogs bcas la// gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dngos grub stsol// bskyed pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor gyad du gyur// sngags kyi sgra gdangs rdo rje nā dar gyur// bde chen ting 'dzin mkha' khyab 'khor lor sad// phyogs bral blo 'das go 'phang mngon gyur shog /
ces pa'ang rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor pa karma dam chos dpal grub kyi ngor karma pa'i skyes rabs bco lnga par grags pas bris//
